barriers.reason: Power shutoffs twice this month mean insulin may not stay refrigerated.

alternatives.text: Complete the utility medical certification form to delay disconnection because insulin needs refrigeration.
Apply for LIHEAP utility bill help through CEDA in Cook County; check current funding window.

barriers.reason: 10 AM appointment conflicts with 6 AM-2 PM warehouse shift and no sick days.
Patient reports no transportation and neighborhood transit access is limited.

alternatives.text: Ask endocrinology for a later appointment after 2 PM to match the patient's shift end.
Medicaid covers non-emergency medical transport; call Lakeshore Community Health Plan (number on plan card) to book a ride.

barriers.reason: 2 PM Thursday class is at shift end; patient has no sick days and loses pay for missed shifts.

alternatives.text: Request an evening or weekend diabetes class, or ask if the class can start after 2 PM.
